Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> reignited her fighting spirit, vowing never to fail again.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は二度と失敗しないと意気込みを燃やした。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>燃起斗志，发誓绝不再犯同样的错。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>燃起鬥志，發誓絕不再犯同樣的錯。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ne fera plus d'erreur et allumera le feu de sa détermination.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> wird sich nicht wieder irren und hat sich heute Morgen selbst angezündet.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> no volverá a fallar, encenderé mi espíritu.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> promete não cometer o mesmo erro novamente e acenderá o fogo.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> จะไม่ทำผิดซ้ำอีก และจะจุดไฟให้สว่างไสว
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tidak akan mengulang kesalahan dan akan membakar semangatnya.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sẽ không bao giờ lặp lại sai lầm và sẽ đốt cháy lòng tự tôn của ngươi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से अपनी लड़ने की भावना जगाई, और कसम खाई कि वह फिर कभी असफल नहीं होगी।

Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> est rentré(e) chez lui/elle, complètement épuisé(e)…
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> schleppte sich völlig erschöpft nach Hause …
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> regresó a casa arrastrando los pies, completamente agotada…
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>เดินกลับบ้านอย่างเหนื่อยล้า…
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> पूरी तरह से थका हुआ, घर की ओर चल पड़ा…

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 포션을 먹고 정신을 차린 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(와)과 돌아가는 길에 네탓 공방을 벌였다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After drinking the potion and recovering her spirits, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> and I ended up bickering on the way back.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: ポーションを飲んで気を取り直した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>と、帰り道で言い争いをした。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 与喝完药水打起精神的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>，在回去的路上互相推卸责任了起来。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 與喝完藥水打起精神的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>，在回去的路上互相推卸責任了起來。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après avoir repris ses esprits grâce à la potion, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> m'a reproché d'en être la cause sur le chemin du retour.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nachdem <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> den Trank getrunken und ihren Geist wiedererlangt hatte, stritten wir uns auf dem Rückweg.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Después de beber la poción y recuperar el ánimo, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> y yo terminamos discutiendo de camino a casa.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Depois de beber a poção e recuperar o ânimo, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> e eu acabamos trocando acusações no caminho de volta.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: หลังจากดื่มยาและฟื้นตัว <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> กับผม/ฉันก็เกิดการต่อสู้ระหว่างทางกลับ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah meminum ramuan dan pulih dari keadaan pusing, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dan aku berkelahi dalam perjalanan pulang.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi uống thuốc và hồi phục tinh thần, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> và tôi lại cãi nhau trên đường về.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: पोशन पीने और अपनी हिम्मत जुटाने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> और मैं वापस जाते समय झगड़ पड़े।
